source.role: source-derived oracle; licensed reference executable unavailable

scope.vector_controls: Numeric pairs, scalars, integers, surface dimensions and sampled planar paths; other present control payloads explicitly refuse.

semantics.rotate_along: when true, add circular angle to rotation; when false, omit it
semantics.path_metrics: each copy retains source segment counts, lengths, accumulated lengths, and sampled weights
semantics.bounds: output getter uses the default unit bounds [0,0]-[1,1]
semantics.processor_arrays: evaluate each processor row into an independent complete repeated path
semantics.animation: Path-linked vector controls sample at their own local raw animator X ratio before processor rows; surface and sampled path getters bypass reference conversion.
semantics.empty_result: zero amount or missing/default path produces zero lines and zero metrics; sampling returns the supplied output unchanged
semantics.units: Reference primitive vectors, including linked numbers and vectors, multiply by project width and height. Pixel values are unchanged.
semantics.amount_getter: The source Int getter rounds numeric values before executor admission.

bounds.amount: Normalized nonnegative integral count within MaximumArrayElements; negative source allocation sizes are unsupported.
bounds.work: REPEAT_WORK_LIMIT = 2^24, checked against processor rows, copies, path lines, and estimated child runtime work
bounds.bytes: reserve caller evaluation budget before construction; enforce MaximumEvaluationBytes per result and processor row
bounds.payload: validate source depth, cloned operation count, line count, and output payload before returning
